reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "New CRD `ciliumnodeconfigs.cilium.io` (CiliumNodeConfig, v2, v2alpha1)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: A new API group cilium.io/v2/CiliumNodeConfig becomes available; operators who manage CRDs separately must install this CRD before upgrading.

proposed.statement: A new CiliumNodeConfig custom resource definition (group cilium.io, versions v2 and v2alpha1) is introduced in the target release.
